name: Prophets
overview: Scripture presents prophets as individuals who walk closely with God, as exemplified by Enoch who walked with God and was taken by Him (Genesis 5:22, 24). Their role often involves divine revelation and counsel, influencing the course of history as seen in the blessings and curses pronounced by Noah (Genesis 9:25-26). Prophets bear significant responsibilities and face challenges such as rejection and persecution, yet they remain vital in communicating God's will and preserving His truth.
